newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 904 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 904 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade's Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 904 contracts, according to the CBOT.
There were 49 wheat, 572 corn, 222 soybean, 2 soymeal and 2 soyoil futures contracts traded along with 45 corn put, 6 corn call, 5 soybean put and one soybean call options.

The overnight trend for corn was down 1/2 to up 3/4 cent per bushel, soybeans down 1/4 to up 1-1/2 cents per bushel, wheat up 1/4 to one cent per bushel, soymeal down $0.60 per ton and soyoil up 0.01 cent a lb.
